beats.say: 18 years: Walter Koenig served as best man for his dearest friend.
That is longer than the original Star Trek television series and its first five films combined.
Variety says George Takei led the tributes after Koenig passed away on 25 October 2026.
The pair were famous for navigating the USS Enterprise as Chekov and Sulu.
But their bond went far beyond the screen when Koenig stood by Takei at his 2008 wedding.
Takei wrote for us to keep navigating a steady course in honour of his friend.
Variety reports the actor even received the Platinum Award for Best Actor in 2026.
